    /*  GENERATED by tools/gen_train_models.py. Do not edit.

        The cars of a train, the deck between two, and the digits of a car's
        number (DESIGN.md 3.3). Each is drawn by every client as a 3D item
        in the world pass (TRN_Body.lua): a carrier item is told which of
        these to be by its bare name, and a model's name with no dot is
        looked up in module Base. A unit is a tile, y is up, and a car's
        front is its +x.

        scale is 0.6667 because drawn this way a model comes out half as
        big again as its mesh: at 1.0 a seven-tile car was about ten and a
        half tiles long on screen (PLAYED and measured off a screenshot,
        2026-10-08; where the engine applies it has not been found).  */
